text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking at all times on both sides of Riverview Drive, between the east end of the street and a point 35 metres west. The proposed parking prohibition on Riverview Drive will address residents' concerns with parked vehicles making it difficult for large vehicles to turn around at the end of the street.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on both sides of Riverview Drive, between the east end of the street and a point 35 metres west.
